partner_result_applied.applied_equation: After conditioning a physical curvature cover R with C[L,L]=0, the residual Q=F_r(X)+2X^T M_L Y_L+beta_r^T Y_L+c_r is exactly in the clean-bank theorem.

new_claim.statement: For Q=F(X)+2X^T M Y+Y^T C Y+b^T Y+c on original product banks, if R is a physical curvature cover with C[L,L]=0 and M[:,L] has top two singular values s1>=s2>0, then ||p_Q||_infinity<=2sqrt(pi)(s1s2)^(-1/2) and p_Q has a C0 representative. With top-two X-projection density cap L_X the numerator improves to sqrt(2pi L_X).
new_claim.structural_identity: M_L M_L^T=M M^T-M_R M_R^T, so s2(M_L)^2>=s2(M)^2-||M_R||_op^2.

explicit_application.family: Two-coordinate X-bank, diffuse m-leaf crossing L_m with half columns (2/sqrt(m))(1,1) and half (2/sqrt(m))(1,-1), plus an order-one Y-curvature star centered at one conditioned physical coordinate.
explicit_application.spectral_check: Two positive and two negative ambient eigenvalues have modulus at least (7-sqrt(5))/4>1 by Weyl.
explicit_application.grouped_currency: L_m L_m^T=4I_2 while each nonzero individual leaf-pair determinant equals 8/m.

next_step: Analyze the strongly intertwined dense-curvature case: prove that if every physical curvature vertex cover deletes a target-scale portion of the second grouped crossing direction, then one of the completed pair/D5/ridge/projected-crossing/grouped-hub receivers must fire.
